question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: PROPITIOUS
solution:
The correct answer is: **Favorable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Propitious"** means something that is favorable, promising, or indicating a high likelihood of success. (अनुकूल)
 
 
• **Example: **The sunny weather on the day of the picnic was certainly propitious.
 
 
• **"Favorable"** refers to conditions or circumstances that are advantageous or beneficial. (अनुकूल)
 
 
• **Example: **The team was given favorable odds of winning the championship.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Propitious' **is **'Favorable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Favorable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Doubtful **(संदेहपूर्ण): Feeling uncertain or unsure about something.
 
 
• **Example:** The outcome of the experiment was doubtful due to insufficient data.
 
 
• **Harmful **(हानिकारक): Causing damage or injury.
 
 
• **Example: ** Smoking is harmful to your health.
 
 
• **Unlucky** (अभाग्यशाली): Having bad luck or experiencing unfortunate events.
 
 
• **Example:** He was unlucky to miss the bus by just a few seconds.
